(6 units - 0.60m x 1.0m x 1.0m x 7.0M single barrel pipe culvert
Including concrete catch basin, headwall, wingwall and slab)
Completion of the Works is required two eighty (280) calendar days upon receipt of Letter
of Acceptance. Bidders should have completed a contract similar to the Project. The
description of an eligible bidder is contained in the Bidding Documents, particularly, in
Section II. Instructions to Bidders.
3. Bidding will be conducted through open competitive bidding procedures using non-
discretionary "pass/fail" criterion as specified in the 2016 Revised Implementing Rules and
Regulations (IRR) of Republic Act 9184 (RA 9184), otherwise known as the "Government
Procurement Reform Act".
Bidding is restricted to Filipino citizens/sole proprietorships, cooperatives, and
partnerships or organizations with at least seventy five percent (75%) interest or
outstanding capital stock belonging to citizens of the Philippines.
4. Interested bidders may obtain further information from the Municipality of Miagao and
inspect the Bidding Documents at the address given below during office hours from 8:00
a.m to 5:00 p.m.
Office of the Municipal Mayor
Municipal Building, Mueda St.
Miagao, Iloilo
5. A complete set of Bidding Documents may be acquired by interested bidders on October
22-November 12, 2018 from the address below and upon payment of the applicable fee
for the Bidding Documents, pursuant to the latest Guidelines by the GPPB in the amount
of Twenty Five Thousand (P 25,000.00) Pesos.
Office of the Municipal Treasurer
Municipal Building, Mueda St.
Miagao, Iloilo
